text: APPROVE. The extraction keeps the same eager enumeration, the same skip-on-IOException/UnauthorizedAccessException behavior, the same push-then-list-files order and the same `testdata` filtering, while removing the nested try/catch and the `if` from the method, which should bring its complexity under 15. I could not build it here, so one assumption is unchecked: `System.Linq` must be in scope for `Where`, which implicit usings would normally provide.
